description:
[Deterministic regulatory contract audit. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Audits ICT third-party service provider contracts under DORA Articles 28-30: mandatory exit strategies, regulator inspection rights, EEA data processing location guarantees, subcontractor change notification windows, and 24h incident reporting clauses.
Usage: Use this tool to audit ICT vendor agreements for financial institutions. For entity NIS2 classification, use 'nis2_criticality_classifier'. For cyber incident triage, use 'incident_severity_triage'.
Returns: JSON object with { isCompliant: boolean, compliantClausesCount: number, missingClauses: string[], riskLevel: 'LOW' | 'MEDIUM' | 'CRITICAL', recommendations: string[] }.

contractClauses.description: Key contractual clauses required by DORA Art. 30

hasDataLocationEeaGuaranteed.description: Contractual guarantee that data rests and processes in the EEA

hasExitStrategyTransitionPlan.description: Mandatory transition period and vendor handover plan

hasFullSlaDescription.description: Guaranteed quantitative and qualitative service levels

hasIncidentNotificationWindowHours.description: Maximum contractual hours to notify security incidents (e.g. 24)

hasRegulatorAuditAccess.description: Unrestricted inspection and audit rights for competent authorities and ECB

hasSubcontractorPriorNotification.description: Mandatory prior notice before critical subcontracting changes

hasTerminationRightsForBreach.description: Explicit early termination rights for security non-compliance

isCriticalFunction.description: Whether this service supports a critical or important financial function

providerName.description: ICT third-party service provider name (e.g. AWS Europe, Microsoft Azure)

name: dora_third_party_risk
